ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The graph of the linear function $y=ax+b$ and the direct proportion function $y=kx$ are shown in the same Cartesian coordinate system as in the figure. What is the solution set of the inequality $ax+b\geq kx$ with respect to $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} The intersection point of the two lines is $(-1, 2)$. Given that for $x \geq -1$, the line $y=kx$ lies below the line $y=ax+b$, therefore, the solution set of the inequality $ax+b \geq kx$ is $x \geq -1$.\\
Hence, the solution set is $\boxed{x \geq -1}$.
